0x000B4E.en: Short for 'Identification Friend Foe,' a device that identifies units as friend or foe.

0x00168F.en: Short for Extra Over Technology - alien super-technology found in 'Meteor 3,' the meteorite that fell on Aidoneus Island. Analyzed by the <EOTI Organization> under Dr. Bian Zoldark, it revolutionized many fields, above all military technology, but its use was controlled by the <EOT Special Council> and saw almost no civilian application.

0x0021F6.en: The Inspectors were aliens from another star system who had been auditing Earth's civilization. Judging that humanity's insatiable fighting spirit would disturb galactic order, they schemed to control the Earth Sphere. The name 'Inspectors', coined offhandedly by their commander Vigagi while fighting the Hiryu Custom, became Earth's codename for them; their true name is unknown. Invading in New Era 187, their blitz seized the <White Star>, the Moon and key parts of North America. But caught between the Federation counteroffensive 'Operation Plantagenet' and the mass <Einst> outbreak, they were forced off Earth, then beaten at the White Star by the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom. With supreme commander Wendolo and other leaders dead, the Inspectors were destroyed - though some call them a mere advance force.

0x003787.en: One type of 'barrier' - defenses that nullify enemy attacks. It directly projects non-physical energy: EM waves, gravity, telekinesis, photons, etc. Fields are matched to the attack, working by neutralization, diffusion, compression, cancellation, distortion, etc. Airborne matter may crystallize on the field's surface, seeming to 'shatter' when it fails.

0x004659.en: A man-machine interface developed by Egret Feff, a scientist at the giant hibernation facility, the <Earth Cradle>, with Adler's backing. It direct-links pilot and machine for smoother control, and can also act on the pilot from the machine side, forcibly boosting aggression and reaction speed. At present, pilots cannot endure prolonged use without undergoing some form of enhancement.

0x0058A1.en:
A conflict waged by the 'Shura,' warriors from the otherworld Shura Realm. With that world nearing ruin, Alkaid, king of Ra, led the Shura aboard 'Tenku Majo' (Earth codename: Swordian), a giant sword-shaped structure able to cross dimensions, to seek a new home. Arriving after the <Inspector Incident>, they invaded Earth with the mobile weapons called the <Shura God>. Cities fell before the Hagane and Hiryu Custom raided the fortress in 'Operation Overgate,' defeating Alkaid with Folka Albark and others who had questioned the Shura way and sided with Earth.
Afterward Folka and the surviving Shura left aboard the fortress.

0x0068B8.en:
Semi-organic weapons ancient China created to fight the demons called the 'Hundred Evils.' They have minds of their own and can act alone, but show their true power only when piloted by a telekinetic they accept. Ordinary humans can board them, but their life force drains away - fatally, at worst.
Ranks include the 'Four Spirits,' 'Four Gods,' and 'Four Perils'; machines besides RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh likely exist, but details are unknown.

0x006D60.en:
Tactical Cybernetics Operating System: the OS of <Personal Trooper>s and other humanoid mobile weapons. When a pilot selects an action such as 'strike the enemy,' its AI computes both machines' positions and picks the most efficient, appropriate motion from the pattern data stored in the machine.
This frees the pilot from complex manual control: with minimal input focused on situational judgment, the machine automatically performs a suitable motion to achieve the intended action. Pilots can also set the types and execution priority of motion pattern data, tuning the machine's movements to their own habits and preferences.

0x008003.en: QA high-efficiency reaction thruster developed at the <Tesla Leicht Institute>. By altering gravitational mass (weight) and inertial mass (resistance to motion) separately, it accelerates propellant to drive objects efficiently - a kind of gravity control. It eases atmospheric and space flight, but early units fit only warships. Analysis of Meteor 3's <EOT> greatly advanced gravity-control physics, shrinking and improving the drive; from the <DC>'s Armored Modules on, 20-meter humanoid weapons could mount it.

0x008BA4.en: Special humanoid mobile weapons, popularly called Super Robots: mainly units over 40 meters with special power sources or systems.

0x009C0D.en: A general term for humanoid mobile weapons developed to counter the 10-meter-plus articulated mobile weapons the Aerogaters were believed to possess. The first Personal Trooper, the <Mao Industries> PTX-001 Gespenst, rolled out in New Era 180. It features easy weapon swapping via manipulators and high mobility from bipedal walking and hovering. Under the <TC-OS> the pilot focuses on judgment: minimal input lets the machine automatically select motions to achieve the pilot's intent.

0x00A339.en: An interstellar flight program using mid-sized ships, begun under the <DC>. It develops starships and trains their pilots. After the DC fell it continued under Federation control, backed by <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; its craft and systems also see military use. "TD" means "<Tesla Drive>" and "Terrestrial Dream."

0x00B02D.en: Humanoid weapons of <La Gias>. Once meaning only the Holy Kingdom of Langran's sixteen machines, the term now covers all such units since mass-produced types appeared.

0x00B86B.en: A world inside the Earth. Though shaped like the inside of a hollow sphere, it is not literally the planet's interior; its phase is shifted from ours. La Gias means 'the true land.'

0x00C010.en: A homogenized force field around the unit warps kinetic energy crossing the sphere's edge, dispersing it as tension along the boundary. EM waves lose their waveform, so beams and solid rounds alike may be nullified.
